movers.headline: signs a contract with the Indian Navy for the construction of five Next Generation Corvettes, valued at Rs 32,000 cr
wins fresh private-sector wagon orders: a GATX India LOI (Rs 214.94 cr) and a Chetak International order (Rs 109.10 cr)

order_wins: **Panache Digilife** -- Rs 51.43 cr work order to supply laptops with accessories to a domestic IT-sector customer, executable in about 30 days (~5.1% of mcap).
**Datakosa** -- 12-month work order of USD 24,65,280 (about Rs 23.38 cr per the filing's own conversion; ~65.0% of mcap) from Hermes Networks Inc, USA, for AI-led automation and integration services.
**Jyoti Structures** -- Purchase Order of Rs 20.85 cr from Torrent Power for shifting the 400 kV DGEN Navsari transmission line, a turnkey job to be completed in six months (~1.8% of mcap).
**Workmates Core2Cloud Solution** -- about Rs 11.50 cr over three years to migrate an undisclosed payments-technology and financial-software company's workloads to AWS (~2.1% of mcap).
**Accord Transformer & Switchgear** -- Rs 4.135 cr of purchase orders from four customers, including Rs 2.65 cr from Megha Engineering, for EV-charging and electrical equipment (~2.5% of mcap).
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **U. Y. Fincorp** -- Board proposes a preferential issue of up to 2,45,90,000 convertible warrants (Rs 59.99 cr) and 5,21,20,000 equity shares (Rs 127.17 cr), both at Rs 24.40, subject to shareholder and regulatory approval.
**Amba Auto Sales and Services** -- Board approves a Rs 161.60 cr preferential issue of convertible warrants, subject to shareholder approval at an EGM on 3 December.
**Rajkot Investment Trust** -- Board approves a rights issue of up to Rs 48 cr and a draft letter of offer for exchange in-principle approval; record date to be notified.
**Mihika Industries** -- Rights Issue Committee fixes terms of the Rs 90 cr rights issue approved on 28 October: 9,00,00,000 partly paid-up shares of Rs 10 each.
**Jindal Capital** -- fixes terms and files the Letter of Offer for a Rs 16.22 cr rights issue (3 shares for every 2 held at Rs 15, including Rs 5 premium).
**Artificial Electronics Intelligent Material (AEIM)** -- withdraws its Rs 166.02 cr rights issue, citing unfavourable market conditions and volatility.
equity_allotments: **Ola Electric Mobility** -- allots 37,02,72,665 partly paid-up equity shares (Rs 6 paid up) at Rs 16.20 each on its rights issue, taking paid-up capital to Rs 4,850.57 cr (new_share_allotment).
**Continental Controls** -- allots 1,96,68,019 rights equity shares at Rs 10, completing the rights issue of its 8 October Letter of Offer (new_share_allotment).
**Sun Retail** -- allots 18,90,13,412 fully convertible equity warrants to nine allottees at Rs 1.00 per warrant as the first tranche of its approved preferential issue (new_warrant).
**Retaggio Industries** -- allots 5,04,000 equity shares as the eleventh tranche of warrant conversion; the holder paid the balance 75%, Rs 98.28 lakh (warrant_conversion_past).
**iStreet Network** -- allots 11,66,666 equity shares at Rs 4.50 on warrant conversion, about Rs 0.52 cr (our arithmetic; warrant_conversion_past).
m_and_a: **NBCC (India)** -- signs a non-binding MoU with the Government of Bihar for four Patna redevelopment projects, tentative cost about Rs 2,000 cr by its own estimate; not a contract.
**NBCC (India)** -- separately signs a non-binding MoU with the Government of Rajasthan for the Maharana Pratap Tourist Circuit at Haldighati, sanctioned cost about Rs 168.39 cr.

**Castrol India** -- bp's sale of Castrol to Stonepeak's Motion JVCo closed on 30 October, giving the buyer sole control of Castrol Limited, the promoter holding 51.00% (50,44,52,416 shares) of Castrol India.
**ITC** -- Board approves merging wholly owned Sproutlife Foods (Yoga Bar; turnover Rs 451.71 cr, net worth Rs 5.22 cr) into ITC, effective 1 April 2026, subject to approvals.

**Kalpataru** -- WOS Kalpataru Properties buys the remaining 16.67% of step-down subsidiaries AREPL and AREDPL (Parkcity, Thane) for Rs 52.05 cr plus Rs 0.49 cr, about Rs 52.55 cr in all (our arithmetic).
**UCAL** -- promoter-group buyer Sujo Land and Properties signs to buy a 6.97-acre residential plot of WOS Ucal Polymer Industries, advancing Rs 45 cr pending township approval (related party).
**Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys** -- JSW Renew Energy Twelve allots 2,56,14,000 shares for Rs 25.61 cr as the second tranche, taking IMFA's stake in the JV to 26%.

**Gujarat State Fertilizers & Chemicals** -- renounces its rights entitlement of 18,00,000 shares in subsidiary GPLCL and sells 6,50,000 shares to Gujarat Maritime Board, cutting its stake from 60% to 11%.
**Bondada Engineering** -- subsidiary Atpole Technologies acquires BTM Mobility (formerly Thuraga Motors), an electric two-wheeler maker, extending the group's BLDC-motor business into vehicles.
**Belrise Industries** -- signs a license and technical assistance agreement with Yamato Co (Japan) for air filters, oil filters and resin intake manifolds for Indian OEMs.
**Zydus Lifesciences** -- closes the acquisition of Sterling Biotech's API business under the 17 September 2024 Business Transfer Agreement after closing-date adjustments.
**Shera Energy** -- Board approves a wholly owned subsidiary in Dubai with an investment of up to USD 5 million.
**India Glycols** -- demerged Ennature Bio Pharma and IGL Spirits receive listing and trading approvals under the scheme of arrangement.
**Niyogin Fintech** -- equity shareholders, secured and unsecured creditors pass its composite NCLT scheme with iServeU Technology by the required majority at the 30 October meetings.
capex_core: **Trident** -- Board approves a Rs 4,650 cr capacity expansion and modernisation, including 99,840 spindles at Budhni, sheeting, paper and a 60 MW hybrid renewable project.
**Sukhjit Starch & Chemicals** -- MIDC confirms infrastructure and a dedicated water pipeline for its Rs 550 cr, 1,200 TPD maize-processing unit at Yeola, Nashik; financing mode to be finalised.
**RSWM** -- raises the cost of its Denim Garment facility with NDS9 from Rs 186.30 cr to Rs 208.26 cr, adding a Knit Garments line, plus Rs 46.24 cr into JV subsidiary LNJ NDS9 Global.
**Borana Weaves** -- approves a two-phase, 384-loom expansion at Unit 4 (192 looms each by December 2026 and March 2027), total investment Rs 49.92 cr.
**Shree Pushkar Chemicals & Fertilisers** -- approves Rs 70 cr capex for a new chemical plant at Unit-5, MIDC Lote Parshuram, on its own land.
**Fine Organic Industries** -- raises its investment limit in wholly owned Fine Organic Industries (SEZ) by Rs 120 cr to Rs 420 cr for a new manufacturing unit.
**Forbes & Company** -- approves Rs 35 cr for site works of the first phase of its Wagale, Thane IT Park, and about Rs 15 cr plus GST for a factory building at Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar.
**Nelcast** -- an additional furnace is installed at Ponneri, lifting capacity from 40,000 to 60,000 tonnes a year from January 2027 once the sanctioned power supply is enhanced.
business_updates: **Results season** — 387 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**Baheti Recycling Industries** -- H1 FY27 revenue up 67.69% YoY to Rs 528.47 cr, EBITDA up 99.48% to Rs 42.37 cr, PAT up 105.83% to Rs 19.08 cr; FY28 revenue guidance raised to Rs 1,300 cr from Rs 1,100 cr.
**Capillary Technologies** -- Q2 FY27 operating revenue up 51% YoY (43% constant currency) to Rs 271.35 cr, adjusted EBITDA up 103% to Rs 44.86 cr, PAT Rs 21.92 cr against Rs 0.29 cr.
**Devyani International** -- Q2 FY27 revenue up 10.4% YoY to Rs 1,519 cr, operating EBITDA up 34% to Rs 229 cr, PBT Rs 5.7 cr against a loss; 70 net new stores.
**Puravankara** -- Q2 FY27 revenue up 59% YoY to Rs 1,051 cr, PAT Rs 82 cr against a Rs 42 cr loss; pre-sales up 109% to Rs 2,762 cr; net debt down Rs 470 cr to Rs 2,366 cr.
**Arvind Fashions** -- Q2 FY27 revenue up 10.0% YoY to Rs 1,559 cr, its highest ever, EBITDA up 15.5% to Rs 216 cr, PAT up 29.6% to Rs 49 cr.
**Krsnaa Diagnostics** -- Q2 FY27 revenue up 32% YoY to a record Rs 271 cr; H1 revenue up 27% to Rs 506.5 cr, PAT down to Rs 41.1 cr from Rs 44.5 cr.
**Balmer Lawrie** -- Q2 FY27 net total income up 26.34% YoY to Rs 818.04 cr, PBT up 42.95% to Rs 93.63 cr, PAT up 39.56% to Rs 67.66 cr.

**Lloyds Engineering Works** -- H1 FY27 consolidated revenue up about 110% YoY to Rs 1,120.70 cr, EBITDA up 72.32% to Rs 158.76 cr; consolidated order book Rs 4,591.67 cr against Rs 1,580.99 cr a year earlier.
**Sathlokhar Synergys E&C Global** -- H1 FY27 revenue up 85% YoY to about Rs 502 cr, EBITDA up 131% to about Rs 74 cr, PAT up 120% to about Rs 51 cr; order book Rs 1,239 cr.
**Blue Cloud Softech Solutions** -- SpaceX International accepts October services under the already-disclosed USD 150 million statement of work, invoicing USD 10 million for the month.
**Acme Solar Holdings** -- commissions a further 66.68 MW of the 300 MW Bikaner hybrid project (COD 4 November), taking commissioned solar capacity to 200.04 MW; PPA is with NTPC.
**Bajaj Auto** -- October total sales of 5,91,876 units, up 14% YoY (domestic 3,51,148, +12%; exports 2,40,728, +18%).
**Adani Ports and SEZ** -- October cargo volume of 51 MMT, up 27% YoY led by dry cargo (+36%); year-to-date 331 MMT, up 16%.
**Steel Strips Wheels** -- October net turnover up 55.58% YoY to Rs 647.05 cr, a fourth straight record month, led by aluminium wheels (+66%) and CV wheels (+53%).
**Ashok Leyland** -- October domestic vehicle sales of 20,224 units, up 24% YoY, with M&HCV trucks up 39% to 11,102.
**Atul Auto** -- October three-wheeler sales of 3,560 units, nearly flat YoY (+0.48%), with IC-engine up 9.23% and EV down 23.29%.
**Supreme Infrastructure India** -- completes its court-sanctioned Rs 2,200 cr debt settlement with financial creditors and receives no-dues certificates, leaving the company debt-free.
**Lupin** -- receives US FDA approval for Amifampridine Tablets and, as first-to-file, is eligible for 180-day shared generic exclusivity.
distress_risk: **Jindal Poly Films** -- files an oppression and mismanagement petition at NCLT New Delhi against Brookfield-affiliated Project Holdings Fourteen (DIFC) and its two nominee directors over material subsidiary JPFL Films; impact not assessed.

**Nephrocare Health Services** -- a Tashkent court sets aside the Uzbek tax department's demand of about Rs 14.79 cr (tax Rs 11.50 cr plus penalty Rs 3.29 cr) on subsidiary Nephrocare Central Asia, citing procedural irregularities.
**Technocraft Ventures** -- GST appellate authority allows its appeal against an adjudication demand of about Rs 3.44 cr (tax and equal penalty) over input-tax-credit mismatches.
**EKI Energy Services** -- SEBI adjudication order imposes penalties totalling Rs 88 lakh on the company and individuals; the company disagrees and plans to challenge it.
**Patel Engineering** -- appears before the CBI special court in Lucknow in a corruption case against irrigation officials; no adverse order against the company and no material impact expected.
**AstraZeneca Pharma India** -- Delhi High Court directs NPPA to take no coercive steps on its Symbicort overcharging notice until the 11 January 2027 hearing.
**Neeraj Paper Marketing** -- the income-tax department issues a fresh demand notice for AY 2013-14 after partial appellate relief on a Rs 12.15 lakh dispute.
open_offers: **AI Champdany Industries Ltd** — open offer PA (PA is scanned — open the filing); mcap Rs 89 cr

**Apollo Micro Systems Limited** — Apollo Micro Systems Limited open offer — offer price not parsed from the PA; change of control (Reg 4) + >25% acquisition (Reg 3(1)); tender window not in PA (comes with DPS/LoF); mcap Rs 17,487 cr
**IIFL Capital Services Limited** — open offer PA filed — not in the corp_events ledger yet (next cycle)
other_notable: **Transport Corporation of India** -- extinguishes the 15,62,500 shares bought back in its Rs 150 cr tender-offer buyback at Rs 160 a share, completing the buyback.
**Genus Power Infrastructures** -- files the Letter of Offer for its approved Rs 148.20 cr tender buyback of 47.50 lakh shares at Rs 312.
**Mazagon Dock** -- after a price spike, confirms a media report that it is scouting partners for proposed greenfield shipbuilding hubs reflects its plans, per its CMD interview of 31 October.
**Mindspace Business Parks REIT** -- Manager's board approves H1 FY27 results and declares net asset value of Rs 565.1 per unit as of 30 September.
**Veefin Solutions** -- receives NSE in-principle approval to migrate from the BSE SME platform to the NSE Main Board.
**E2E Networks** -- launches Blaze, a pay-per-token AI inference service for open models, serving domestic and international customers.
**RPSG Ventures** -- step-down subsidiary receives a formation certificate for a new UAE company, RPSG Foods & Health Products Trading FZE.
**TBI Corn** -- incorporates wholly owned UAE subsidiary TBICL (FZE).
**Kaynes Technology** -- completes incorporation of wholly owned subsidiary Kaynes Arabia Electronics Company.
**Kiaasa Retail** -- opens four new exclusive brand outlets across Punjab, Uttarakhand and Uttar Pradesh.
